teams.heading: Jake White named Fiji head coach ahead of 2027 Rugby World Cup
teams.body: Fiji's Nations Championship campaign sits with Jake White, whose appointment ahead of the 2027 World Cup was reported last month. His side slumped to a fourth straight defeat in the inaugural Nations Championship, going down 54-17 to France in Lyon after starting with 10 France-based players, including their entire backline. Ireland are next for the Flying Fijians, who have won none of their four matches.

lead.why: It is the only shortlist item that is a Fiji event rather than a France or Ireland story, and it has not yet been reported in this tab.

teams.heading: Borthwick makes six squad changes as Feyi-Waboso and Curry are ruled out
teams.body: Immanuel Feyi-Waboso, forced off at half-time against Australia with an ankle injury, and Tom Curry, who hurt a hip in training, will play no further part in the Nations Championship. England head coach Steve Borthwick has made six changes to his 36-man squad for Saturday's match against Japan. Max Hicks, Max Ojomoh, Noah Caluori and Tobias Elliott are in, while Ollie Chessum, Seb Atkinson and George Furbank remain in rehabilitation with no definitive timescale. Caluori scored twice and Ojomoh crossed in England A's 59-24 win over Argentina XV.

lead.why: It is England's own squad news: confirmed injury losses and six squad changes ahead of Saturday's match with Japan, which the other shortlist items only comment on.

teams.heading: Jeremy Ward trains with France; Rassie Erasmus says Boks never considered him
teams.body: Stade Français centre Jeremy Ward has been training with Fabien Galthié's France squad this month, though he only qualifies on residency grounds in 2027. The 30-year-old has said he is open to playing for Les Bleus, and Springboks head coach Rassie Erasmus was asked about the switch ahead of Friday's clash in Paris. Erasmus said South Africa had never really considered Ward for a Springbok squad, and that it would be silly to be upset about South African players representing other countries.

lead.why: It is the only fresh item with France at its centre, a South African-born centre training with Galthié's squad, rather than a coach's prediction or a pundit's verdict.

teams.heading: Ciaran Frawley expected to start at out-half against Fiji on Saturday
teams.body: Ciaran Frawley is expected to start at out-half for Saturday's Nations Championship match against Fiji, his second run at No. 10 in four Tests. Jack Crowley remains unavailable through injury, and Frawley, a 16-cap utility player, has spent recent seasons as a utility option rather than a specialist 10. Having kicked the Durban drop goal that beat South Africa in 2024 from the bench, he said he has "definitely matured a lot" since the 2022 tour to New Zealand.

teams.heading: Quesada brings Riccardo Casarin and Antony Italo Miranda into Argentina camp
teams.body: Italy coach Gonzalo Quesada has added two invitees to the Argentina camp: Riccardo Casarin, a centre from Valorugby, and Antony Italo Miranda, a back-rower from Mogliano, both joining after the squad list went out. Casarin captained Italy U20 in the last Six Nations and the Junior Rugby World Cup and has made an URC debut for Zebre; Miranda also played for the U20s last season. Both are joining the camp in Turin as Italy prepare for Saturday's test against Argentina.

lead.why: A fresh selection event for Italy: two invitees added to the Argentina camp by the coach.

teams.heading: Centre Jones says Scotland have yet to prove they're top-tier
teams.body: Jones made the point after last Saturday's 43-21 defeat by New Zealand at Murrayfield. Former captain John Barclay pointed to red-zone efficiency, with Scotland converting 30% of visits to the 22 against New Zealand's 58%. Scotland sit sixth of 12 in the log on two wins and two defeats from four matches, and their next test is against Australia.

teams.heading: Wales face Aaron Wainwright injury doubt for All Blacks clash on Saturday
teams.body: Lydiate, Wales's contact skills coach and a former Wainwright team-mate, described the leg problem as "a minor injury" but said the number eight may not be available. Wainwright, 29, did not train on Tuesday and was still in a protective boot, with Steve Tandy due to name the team on Thursday. If he is out, Taine Basham, the Cardiff number eight, is the likely replacement and would make his first international start since the 2022 Six Nations against England.

teams.heading: Juan Cruz Mallía ruled out of Nations Championship with knee sprain
teams.body: Mallía left the field just after the hour mark in Friday's loss to Ireland in Dublin, and the Argentine Rugby Federation announced on Monday that the Toulouse back will miss the rest of the Nations Championship. Uncapped Tobías Wade, a Zebre back, joins the squad in his place. Coach Felipe Contepomi has also added hookers Bautista Bernasconi and Facundo Bosch after Julián Montoya, who failed a head injury assessment in Dublin, was left in doubt for Saturday's match against Italy in Genoa.

lead.why: A new Argentina-side injury and squad change, announced by the UAR, is a fresh event that Argentina fans will act on.

teams.heading: Angus Bell becomes first player yellow-carded for hip-drop tackle under new law
teams.body: Bell's yellow came after a TMO review in the stoppage for Immanuel Feyi-Waboso's injury, with referee Pierre Brousset deciding it. World Rugby formally outlawed the hip drop on 1 November, so the card is a first under the new rule. Australia went 19-3 down with 14 men, lost 45-22, and Scotland are next. Feyi-Waboso is ruled out of the rest of England's Nations Championship campaign.

lead.why: It is the one new item in the pack about Australia, and the card it reports was the decisive moment of the England defeat.

teams.heading: Japan score 325 points and concede 305 in last 11 games
teams.body: Across their last 11 games, Japan have scored 325 points and conceded 305, averages of 29.5 scored and 27.7 conceded per game. Those figures are the form line into Saturday's Round 5 Test against England. Their biggest win in that window came in September, a 63-14 victory over USA at home in the Pacific Nations Cup Knockout Stage.

teams.heading: Will Jordan sidelined by hamstring tear as Jordie Barrett misses Wales test
teams.body: Will Jordan has been ruled out of Saturday's test against Wales in Cardiff with a minor hamstring tear, and Jordie Barrett will not feature despite passing his head injury assessment after a head-on-head clash against Scotland. The head coach said the side could make several changes from the team that beat Scotland 43-21, with a couple of players set for opportunities.

teams.heading: Rassie Erasmus says Springboks never considered Jeremy Ward, now training with France
teams.body: The Springboks hold no grudge over Jeremy Ward, the Stade Français centre who has been training with France this month and could play for them next year. Erasmus said South Africa never looked at Ward for a Springbok squad in his era, adding that they track players worldwide and are proud of others such as Duhan van der Merwe, Pierre Schoeman and Kyle Steyn, who found opportunities elsewhere.

lead.why: It is the freshest and most widely corroborated item in the pack, and it is a South Africa story about a player switching allegiance to France.
